info.title: CAO dashboard server
info.description: The Go dashboard server HTTP contract. Local mode uses a loopback bearer capability; hosted mode uses an authorized GitHub OAuth session and X-CSRF-Token on protected mutations. The optional MCP HTTP transport is covered, but its protocol messages and tool schemas are owned by the MCP contract; dashboard static assets are outside this contract.

post.description: Start a distributed, asynchronous rebuild; local bearer or hosted admin session and CSRF on hosted mutations. Canonical ingestion and existing-database maintenance curate Audits according to dashboard-data.md section 11.1, including unchanged artifact inputs. Changed retained data publishes a new revision; missing Run evidence, grader/eval identities, and actionable diagnostics remain retained.

post.description: Public signed GitHub delivery (maximum 10 MiB); validated with HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body. Repository created, deleted, archived and unarchived deliveries durably queue repository lifecycle updates; a successful acknowledgement does not mean the database update has completed. Never use dashboard bearer/session credentials for webhook authentication. The body is a GitHub event-specific JSON object.

get.description:
Public in local and hosted profiles, without a bearer capability or OAuth
session. Returns the server's agent guide, documentation links and build
commit SHA (or "unknown"). The guide describes MCP availability but does not
enable the optional MCP endpoint. Hosted requests are limited per client
address; an externally hosted handler returns 503 before startup or after
shutdown.

post.description: Optional stateless streamable HTTP transport, present only when MCP is enabled. Local mode accepts the dashboard bearer capability or a configured GitHub Actions identity; hosted mode requires a repository-scoped GitHub Actions identity (bearer token, actor and signed OIDC token). MCP message formats and tool schemas are maintained by the MCP contract, not this HTTP contract.

RevisionEvent.description: JSON object within each SSE data frame (not the wire framing itself).

ServerLogRedis.description: Only fixed, numeric ingestion counters are returned; Redis keys and values are never exposed.
